tsa-a09-v01.quick_english: That, sevenfold, six-and-half-fold scripture, is taught by the Supreme Lord alone.

tsa-a09-v02.quick_english: There: Śivas, mantra-great-Lords, mantra-Lords, mantras, knowledge-portions, dissolution-portions, complete — seven power-bearing.

tsa-a09-v03.quick_english: Of these seven powers, by their difference up to the earth-and-rest principal tattva: each its own form by fourteen differences — fifteenfold.

tsa-a09-v04.quick_english: There: own form fit-for-knowability, self-established, by grace of Aparābhaṭṭārikā — in power-raised knower-objects the rest-receptacle: that is the śākta form by grace of Śrīmatparāparā; that too sevenfold, from the powers being so many.

tsa-a09-v05.quick_english: In power-bearing-form-principal, in the knower-class, what rests: that power-bearing Siva-form by grace of Śrīmatparābhaṭṭārikā — sevenfold too.

tsa-a09-v06.quick_english: From Śiva to the complete-limit — from those many being said.

tsa-a09-v07.quick_english: There: difference of knower-objects from power-difference alone; for clarification it is said by order of complete-and-rest: in complete, knowledge-portion's power, from being its specific form (mind-action-instrument-powers); dissolution-portion's, those same from objectlessness, in indistinct.

tsa-a09-v08.quick_english: Knowledge-portion's: those same in dissolving-portion, helper of its impression, awakening — pure-knowledge of mantra.

tsa-a09-v09.quick_english: Devoid of that impression: she alone awakened, of mantra-Lord.

tsa-a09-v10.quick_english: She alone, desiring to seize will-power-form, autonomy-natured, of mantra-great-Lord.

tsa-a09-v11.quick_english: Will-natured, distinct-autonomy-natured, of Śiva — thus the power-differences: seven primary.

tsa-a09-v12.quick_english: And difference in power-bearing knower-objects made by its tainting: from instrument-difference ending in agent-difference; from power alone — non-separate — being able to act; not other's, from fallacy of infinite regress and rest.

tsa-a09-v13.quick_english: In reality one alone — consciousness-autonomy-bliss-resting knower; there earth, own-nature-merely-resting, when known, its own nature alone shines: seen-by-mind's-eye, known-by-mind, I-know — there made-by-complete-power, made-by-power-bearing-form, other-own-nature shines too; thus up-to-Siva also to-be-said: Siva-power-established, Siva-nature-resting world I-know — from conviction being different.

tsa-a09-v14.quick_english: But if state's knowability is own body, then knowability-toward-all, knowability-of-knowable too: infinite-regress; by that, world-blindness well-luminous; by that, union-with-opposite-qualities in knowable-unknowable: fault — so said here.

tsa-a09-v15.quick_english: Not that own body: from own-nature being separately said; but what: in knower-power and knower the rest-receptacle, the form — that self-luminous itself shines toward nothing: thus omniscience, infinite-regress-opposite-quality-union — far-removed.

tsa-a09-v16.quick_english: Known-by-infinite-knower-objects too: one alone, its form in those — from one-shining-form-nature: no obstruction by other-knower's-knowing-inference; that its form real, from doing work-for-meaning; likewise seeing beloved seen-by-other becomes-jealous: Siva-nature, seeing rest-pot, enters-completely; seeing reality resting-of-all-infinite-knower-objects becomes-full, like-watching-a-dancer; her blue's form in knower as rest — from self-luminous contemplation's arising: thus fifteenfold-nature of earth up-to-principal-tattva.

tsa-a09-v17.quick_english: In that-much raised-passion-and-rest-curtain's complete's knower-nature: thus fifteenfoldness of complete too, from its that-much knowability.

tsa-a09-v18.quick_english: Spread, this is settled in the Tantrāloka.

tsa-a09-v19.quick_english: From male up to segment-tattva: thirteenfold.

tsa-a09-v20.quick_english: Complete's there, by union-with-knower-nature, from suppression of its two differences power/power-bearing-self: thus complete's own-nature merely; dissolution-portion's in-own-nature, five's in-knower-nature: eleven differences.

tsa-a09-v21.quick_english: Knowledge-portion's in-own-nature, four's in-knower-nature: nine differences.

tsa-a09-v24.quick_english: Mantra-great-Lord's in-own-nature, the Lord's one-alone in-knower-nature, from power-power-bearing-difference: three.

tsa-a09-v25.quick_english: Śiva's too — dependent-on-light-one-consciousness-autonomy: no difference at all, from fullness.

tsa-a09-v26.quick_english: Thus tattva-difference itself established in Supreme-Lord-unsurpassable-policy-one-name makes world-difference-variegation: of hell-heaven-rudra-worlds, earthness being equal too, from farther nature-difference being said.

tsa-a09-v27.quick_english: And here, each-other by construction-of-difference, curious-for-inner-difference-knowledge: let him determine Tantrāloka alone.

tsa-a09-v28.quick_english: Thus by following each pot-and-rest too, earth-and-rest tattvas' difference is established.

tsa-a09-v29.quick_english: Now the whole earth-tattva, knower-known-form targeted, is established: what by earth-tattva-non-difference is light — that Śiva.

tsa-a09-v30.quick_english: As the Vedic text: in earth this very brahman.

tsa-a09-v31.quick_english: It impels giving-earth-tattva-attainment: earth-mantra-great-Lord; impelled earth-mantra-Lord; his made-of-imagined-image-nature expressive mantra, by order of Sāṃkhya-and-rest-bonded-knowledge-crossed-Siva-knowledge, practiced-earth-yoga, not-reached-stable-stage: earth-knowledge-portion.

tsa-a09-v32.quick_english: By bonded-knowledge-order practiced-earth-yoga: at cosmic-end or in death, earth-dissolution-alone.

tsa-a09-v33.quick_english: In deep-sleep from subjection-to-tattva-immersion alone varied dream's arising would be; earth-identity-grasped: earth-complete.

tsa-a09-v34.quick_english: Even here by power-raising-absence-nature: fourteen-foldness — thus earth-tattva's differences of attaining-knower-nature; own-nature pure knowable — thus elsewhere-herein-even.

tsa-a09-v35.quick_english: Now in one knower, by being-established-in-breath, difference-determination here: blue-grasping one, breath sixteen-segment-self up-to-knowable-immersion rises. There first segment indivisible-one-form; second knower-exultation-form; last knowable-identical pervaded; penultimate manifested-knower-form; in middle, the twelve-segment — from among them first six-group non-conceptual-natured, covering-concept sixness by own-nature: one segment; in covering-concept five-form-nature, dawning-willingness, already-dawned — she two-segment-bodied from pulsation's absence-of-one-instant-form, own-work-agent-nature — thus from fivefoldness-of-covering-concept and own-nature six instants non-conceptual; then from non-conceptual's dissolution-likeness: dissolution of concept, dawning-willingness, two-segment-bodied already-dawned: six segments.

tsa-a09-v36.quick_english: Own-work-agent-nature is knower-form-nature — said; she not counted further — thus wise-wealthed practising-teacher's-instruction distinguish fifteenfoldness everywhere by division.

tsa-a09-v37.quick_english: In concept-lack: segment-lack, in bliss-and-rest-knowing like — as far as non-conceptualness-alone.

tsa-a09-v38.quick_english: Worlds too by concept-rest: that ego-made, spread-of-this-being-concept-covered-by-ego, non-conceptual contemplation-abode unlit — consider; suffering-state bliss-resting — like; by concept-decrease she shines indeed — thus this attentiveness in relation of knowable-knower: Abhinavagupta-teachers.

tsa-a09-v39.quick_english: Thus in fifteenfold standing, as far as distinct this-ness-self's difference's lack, so much pair pair diminishes; as far as two-segment Śiva-immersion: there first segment everywhere complete; second pervaded-by-all-knowledge-instruments being-practised, fit for-omniscience-omnipotence — not first.

tsa-a09-v40.quick_english: As Śrīkallaṭa says: segment-fall — here the fall-word: she alone the Goddess Śrīmatkālī, mother-being-nature, Bhairava, intuition — enough, by-secret-and-unsecret.

tsa-a09-v41.quick_english: Thus from mantra-great-Lord-segment onward, from practice of that-and-that, attainment of that-and-that.

tsa-a09-v42.quick_english: Now here the waking-and-rest states are established: the variegation of knowable and its object and consciousness — mutually-relative being — that state: not of knowable-merely, nor of consciousness-merely, nor two separate.

tsa-a09-v43.quick_english: There when by object-rulership, by external-form-nature, shining: waking-state, in-knowable, in-mother, in-measure.

tsa-a09-v44.quick_english: When too right-therein by substratum-form-nature shining — will: dream-state.

tsa-a09-v45.quick_english: When too right-therein by ruler-form-nature shining, by seed-self-nature: deep-sleep-state.

tsa-a09-v46.quick_english: These three known-instrument-knower-states, each by waking-and-rest-difference: fourfold said.

tsa-a09-v47.quick_english: When too in knower-rest-gone, from knower's fullness-turning, by its door fullness-turning shining: fourth-state; she form I-see — of-this-kind triad-of-portions having-crossed I-see-thus: unmediated knower-nature, autonomy-essence, not by sameness-middleness-farness — gives anointing-of-knower-instrument-known-ness, from serving-three-states: threefold.

tsa-a09-v48.quick_english: This four-state-set yogins employ by words piṇḍa-stha-padastha-rūpastha-rūpa-atīta; wealthy-in-contemplation: all-auspicious, pervasion, great-pervasion, accumulation — by words.

tsa-a09-v49.quick_english: Corresponding-sense too here shown in Tantrāloka, in verse-marginalia.

tsa-a09-v50.quick_english: What contained-in-all complete-form — that beyond-fourth, beyond-all, great-accumulation: they establish.

tsa-a09-v51.quick_english: Moreover whose what when form distinct stable continuous — that waking; its opposite dream; which dissolution-portion's enjoyment: all-knowing deep-sleep; which knowledge-portion's enjoyment: identifying-with-enjoyable fourth; mantra-and-rest's: that enjoyment of states Siva-non-difference; beyond-fourth, beyond-all.

tsa-a09-v52.quick_english: There self-nature-complete-pair: 1 dissolution-portion, 2 knowledge-portion, 3 mantra-those-Lords-great-Lords-class, 4 Śiva, 5 — thus in fifteenfold five states.

tsa-a09-v53.quick_english: Self-nature dissolution-portion and-rest-by-order in thirteenfold self-nature knowledge-portion-power; knowledge-portion in-elevenfold self-nature mantras those-Lords great-Lords Śiva — in-ninefold self-nature mantra-Lords great-Lord power Śiva — in-sevenfold self-nature great-Lord-power great-Lord power Śiva — in-fivefold self-nature action-power knowledge-power will-power Śiva — in-threefold, in-non-different too, in Siva-tattva by-structuring-as-action-knowledge-will-bliss-consciousness-form, wealthy-in-contemplation-yoga: five-stage-nature they-say.

tsa-a09-v01.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v01.question: How is the scripture structured?
premises: sa ca saptadhā ṣaḍardhaśāstra eva — it, sevenfold, six-and-half-fold scripture.
paraṃ parameśena uktaḥ — taught by the Supreme Lord alone.
tsa-a09-v01.inference: Structure claim: 7×6.5 by parameśvara-authority — sets the count-schema for the ahnika.

tsa-a09-v02.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v02.question: What are the seven power-bearing?
premises: śivāḥ mantramaheśāḥ mantreśāḥ mantrāḥ vijñānākalāḥ pralayākalāḥ sakalāḥ — seven named.
iti sapta śaktimantaḥ — thus seven power-bearing.
tsa-a09-v02.inference: The ladder: Śiva → mantra-maheśa → mantreśa → mantra → vijñānākala → pralayākala → sakala.

tsa-a09-v03.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v03.question: How do seven powers become fifteen?
premises: eṣāṃ saptaiva śaktayaḥ — of these seven powers.
tadbhedāt pṛthivyādipradhānatattvāntam — by their difference up to earth-principal-tattva.
caturdaśabhir bhedaiḥ pratyekaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ pañcadaśam — fourteen differences each own form: fifteenfold.
tsa-a09-v03.inference: 7 + 8 = 15 via fourteen bhedas to pṛthivī-pradhāna: the pañcadaśa count is difference-generated.

tsa-a09-v04.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v04.question: What is the śākta rūpa in power-raised knower-objects?
premises: svaṃ rūpaṃ prameyatāyogyaṃ svātmaniṣṭham — own form fit-for-knowability, self-established.
aparābhaṭṭārikānugrahāt — by grace of Aparābhaṭṭārikā.
pramātṛṣu udriktaśaktiṣu yat viśrāntibhājanaṃ — the rest-receptacle in power-raised knower-objects.
tat tasyaiva śāktaṃ rūpaṃ — that is the śākta form.
śrīmatparāparānugrahāt — by grace of Śrīmatparāparā.
tat ca saptavidhaṃ — sevenfold too, from the powers' count.
tsa-a09-v04.inference: Two-grace schema: Aparā → prameyatā-rūpa; parāparā → śaktimat-rūpa; both sevenfold by the same arithmetic.

tsa-a09-v05.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v05.question: And the śiva-rūpa side?
premises: śaktimadrūpapradhāne tu — in power-bearing-form-principal.
pramātṛvarge yat viśrāntaṃ — what rests in the knower-class.
tat śaktimac chivarūpam — that power-bearing Siva-form.
śrīmatparābhaṭṭārikānugrahāt — by grace of Śrīmatparābhaṭṭārikā.
tad api saptavidham — sevenfold too.
tsa-a09-v05.inference: Third grace: parābhaṭṭārikā → śiva-rūpa in pramātṛ-varga; the sevenfold pattern repeats thrice.

tsa-a09-v06.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v06.question: Why seven each time?
premises: pramātṝṇāṃ śivāt prabhṛti sakalāntānām — knower-objects from Śiva to sakala-limit.
tāvatām uktatvāt — from those-many being said.
tsa-a09-v06.inference: Count-justification: as many knower-objects as named, so seven per rūpa.

tsa-a09-v07.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v07.question: How do knower-objects differ?
premises: śaktibhedād eva pramātṝṇāṃ bhedaḥ — difference of knower-objects from power-difference alone.
sphuṭīkaraṇārthaṃ sakalādikrameṇa bhaṇyate — for clarification said by sakala-first order.
sakalasya vidyākale śaktiḥ tadviśeṣarūpatvāt — in sakala's knowledge-portion: power, from being its specific form (buddhi-karma-ākṣa powers).
pralayākalasya tu te eva nirviṣayatvāt asphuṭe — pralayākala's: those same, from objectlessness, indistinct.
tsa-a09-v07.inference: Bheda = śakti-bheda only; the ladder-order exposition types each level by its power's specificity or objectlessness.

tsa-a09-v08.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v08.question: What happens at vijñānākala?
premises: vijñānākalasya te eva vigalatkalpe — those same, in dissolving-portion.
tatsaṃskārasacivā — helper of its impression.
prabudhyamānā śuddhavidyā mantrasya — awakening: pure-knowledge of mantra.
tsa-a09-v08.inference: Vijñānākala = impression-helper awakening śuddhavidyā — the transition into mantra.

tsa-a09-v09.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v09.question: And mantreśa?
premises: tatsaṃskārahīnā saiva prabuddhā mantreśasya — devoid of that impression: she alone awakened, of mantra-Lord.
tsa-a09-v09.inference: Mantreśa's śuddhavidyā is impression-free (sanskāra-hīnā) — a purer awakening than mantra's.

tsa-a09-v10.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v10.question: What does she want at maheśa?
premises: saiva icchāśaktirūpatāṃ svātantryasvabhāvāṃ jighṛkṣantī — she alone desiring will-power-form, autonomy-natured.
mantramaheśvarasya — of mantra-great-Lord.
tsa-a09-v10.inference: The ascent: at maheśa she seeks icchā-śakti-rūpa with svātantrya-svabhāva.

tsa-a09-v11.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v11.question: Summarize the seven power-differences.
premises: icchātmikā — will-natured (śiva's? no: list).
sphuṭasvātantryātmikā śivasya — distinct-autonomy-natured of Śiva.
iti śaktibhedāḥ sapta mukhyāḥ — thus seven primary power-differences.
tsa-a09-v11.inference: The seven fold back: icchātmikā … sphuṭasvātantryātmikā-śiva — primary differences closed.

tsa-a09-v12.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v12.question: Why is knower-difference really power-difference?
premises: taduparāgakṛtaś ca śaktimatsu pramātṛṣu bhedaḥ — difference in power-bearing knower-objects made by its tainting.
karaṇabhedasya kartṛbhedaparyavasānāt — instrument-difference ends in agent-difference.
śakter eva ca avyatiriktāyāḥ karaṇīkartuṃ śakyatvāt — power alone non-separate being able to act.
na anyasya anavasthādyāpatteḥ — not other's, from infinite-regress fallacy.
tsa-a09-v12.inference: Eliminative argument: only power can be karaṇī-kartṛ; attributing difference to anything else regresses — hence bheda = uparāga of śakti.

tsa-a09-v13.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v13.question: What is reality behind the differences?
premises: vastutaḥ punar eka eva citsvātantryānandaviśrāntaḥ pramātā — in reality one, consciousness-autonomy-bliss-resting knower.
pṛthivī svarūpamātraviśrāntā yadā vedyate tadā svarūpam asyāḥ kevalaṃ bhāti — when earth known as own-nature-merely, its own nature alone shines.
caitracakṣurdṛṣṭaṃ caitraviditaṃ jānāmīti — mind's-eye-seen, mind-known, I-know.
tatra sakalaśaktikṛtaṃ ... svarūpāntaraṃ bhāty eva — there made-by-complete-power other-own-nature shines too.
śivāntam api vācyaṃ ... viśvaṃ jānāmi iti pratyayasya vilakṣaṇasya bhāvāt — up-to-Siva: Siva-power-established world I-know, from conviction being different.
tsa-a09-v13.inference: Ekatva-doctrine: one pramātā; the 'other-form' shining is power-made, not second-reality — the jānāmi-pratyaya differs from ordinary cognition precisely there.

tsa-a09-v14.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v14.question: What objection does the regress raise?
premises: nanu bhāvasya cet vedyatā svaṃ vapuḥ — if state's knowability is own body.
tat sarvān prati vedyatvaṃ vedyatvam api vedyam — knowability-toward-all, knowability-of-knowable too: knowable.
ity anavasthā — infinite regress.
tayā ca jagato 'ndhasuptatvaṃ suprakāśam eva — by that, world-blindness well-luminous.
tayā ca vedyatvāvedyatve viruddhadharmayoga iti doṣaḥ — opposite-qualities union: fault.
tsa-a09-v14.inference: Classical three-pronged objection (anavasthā, andha-suptatva, viruddha-dharma) against naive vedyatā.

tsa-a09-v15.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v15.question: How is the objection answered?
premises: na tat svaṃ vapuḥ svarūpasya pṛthaguktatvāt — not own body: from own-nature being separately said.
kiṃ tarhi tat pramātṛśaktau pramātari ca yat viśrāntibhājanaṃ — but what: the rest-receptacle in knower-power and knower.
tat khalu tat svaprakāśam eva tat prakāśate na tu kiṃcid api prati — that self-luminous itself shines toward nothing.
iti sarvajñatvam anavasthāviruddhadharmayogaś ca iti dūrāpāstam — thus omniscience; regress and opposite-union far-removed.
tsa-a09-v15.inference: Answer: 'own body' was mislocated — vedyatā = viśrānti-bhājana in pramātṛ-śakti, self-luminous toward no object: sarvajñatā without regress.

tsa-a09-v16.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v16.question: How can one form serve infinite knower-objects?
premises: anantapramātṛsaṃvedyam api ekam eva tat — known-by-infinite-knower-objects too: one alone.
tasya rūpaṃ tāvati teṣām ekābhāsarūpatvāt — its form in those, from one-shining-form-nature.
na pramātrantarasaṃvedanānumānavighnaḥ kaścit — no obstruction by other-knower's knowing-inference.
tat ca tasya rūpaṃ satyam arthakriyākāritvāt — that its form real, from doing work-for-meaning.
paradṛśyamānāṃ kāntāṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyai samīrṣyati — jealous-seeing beloved: analogy of one-form-many-viewers.
śivasvabhāvaṃ viśrāntikumbhaṃ paśyan samāviśati — seeing Siva-nature rest-pot: enters completely.
samastānantapramātṛviśrāntaṃ vastu paśyan pūrṇībhavati nartakīprekṣaṇavat — seeing all-infinite-rest reality: full, like watching dancer.
tasyaiva nīlasya tadrūpaṃ pramātari yat viśrāntaṃ — her blue's form in knower as rest.
tathaiva svaprakāśasya vimarśasyodayāt — from self-luminous contemplation's arising.
iti pañcadaśātmakatvaṃ pṛthivyāḥ prabhṛti pradhānatattvaparyantam — fifteenfold-nature earth to principal-tattva.
tsa-a09-v16.inference: Ekābhāsa solution: one rūpa shines in all (like blue seen by many, dancer watched by crowd); real by artha-kriyā; the fifteenfold is this shining's structure.

tsa-a09-v17.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v17.question: Why is sakala fifteenfold too?
premises: tāvaty udriktarāgādikañcukasya sakalasya pramātṛtvāt — complete's knower-nature from raised-passion-curtain.
sakalasyāpi evaṃ pāñcadaśyam — complete's fifteenfoldness too thus.
tasyāpi tāvad vedyatvāt — from its that-much knowability.
tsa-a09-v17.inference: The curtain (rāga-kañcu) supplies the extra 'that-much' vedyatā making sakala pañcadaśa as well.

tsa-a09-v18.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v18.question: Where is this settled?
premises: vitatya caitat nirṇītaṃ tantrāloke — spread, this is settled in Tantrāloka.
tsa-a09-v18.inference: Cross-reference: Tantrāloka carries the full spread.

tsa-a09-v19.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v19.question: What is the thirteenfold range?
premises: puṃsaḥ prabhṛti kalātattvāntam — from male up to segment-tattva.
trayodaśadhā — thirteenfold.
tsa-a09-v19.inference: The puṃsaḥ→kalā-tattva span runs thirteen — a second count-system beside pañcadaśa.

tsa-a09-v20.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v20.question: What are eleven differences?
premises: sakalasya tatra pramātṛtāyogena tacchaktiśaktimadātmano bhedadvayasya pratyastamayāt — complete's, from suppression of its two differences by knower-nature-union.
tathā ca sakalasya svarūpatvam eva kevalam — thus complete's own-nature merely.
pralayākalasya svarūpatve pañcānāṃ pramātṛtve ekādaśa bhedāḥ — pralayākala's own-nature, five's knower-nature: eleven differences.
tsa-a09-v20.inference: Count-shift: suppression of two bhedas at sakala collapses to one; pralayākala's five-pramātṛtve yields 11.

tsa-a09-v21.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v21.question: Nine differences for vijñānākala?
premises: vijñānākalasya svarūpatve caturṇāṃ pramātṛtve nava bhedāḥ — own-nature, four's knower-nature: nine.

tsa-a09-v22.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v22.question: Seven for mantra?
premises: mantrasya svarūpatve trayāṇāṃ pramātṛtve sapta — three's knower-nature: seven.

tsa-a09-v23.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v23.question: Five for mantreśa?
premises: mantreśasya svarūpatve dvayoḥ pramātṛtve pañca — two's: five.

tsa-a09-v24.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v24.question: Three for maheśa?
premises: mantramaheśasya svarūpatve bhagavata ekasyaiva pramātṛtve — one's knower-nature.
śaktiśaktimadbhedāt trayaḥ — from power-power-bearing-difference: three.

tsa-a09-v25.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v25.question: Any differences for Śiva?
premises: śivasya tu prakāśaikacitsvātantryanirbharasya — dependent on light-one-consciousness-autonomy.
na ko 'pi bhedaḥ paripūrṇatvāt — no difference at all, from fullness.
tsa-a09-v25.inference: Śiva-level: zero bheda — paripūrṇatā closes the descending count (11/9/7/5/3/0).

tsa-a09-v26.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v26.question: What does this difference-doctrine accomplish?
premises: tattvabheda eva parameśvarānuttaranayaikākhye nirūpitaḥ — tattva-difference established in Supreme-policy-one-name.
bhuvanabhedavaicitryaṃ karoti — makes world-difference-variegation.
narakasvargarudrabhuvanānāṃ pārthivatve samāne 'pi dūratarasya svabhāvabhedasya uktatvāt — even with equal earthness, farther nature-difference said.
tsa-a09-v26.inference: One-name policy + bheda-doctrine = variegated worlds: hell/heaven/rudra differ in svabhāva despite shared pārthivatva.

tsa-a09-v27.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v27.question: Where should the curious go next?
premises: parasparaṃ bhedakalanayā — each-other by construction-of-difference.
avāntarabhedajñānakutūhalī — curious for inner-difference-knowledge.
tantrālokam eva avadhārayet — determine Tantrāloka alone.
tsa-a09-v27.inference: Pedagogical redirect: the inner-bheda curiosity is served by Tantrāloka, not here.

tsa-a09-v28.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v28.question: What does the pot-example establish?
premises: ekaikaghaṭādyanusāreṇāpi — by following each pot and rest too.
pṛthivyādīnāṃ tattvānāṃ bhedo nirūpitaḥ — earth-and-rest tattvas' difference is established.
tsa-a09-v28.inference: Nirūpaṇa by example: per-object tracking grounds the tattva-bheda claim.

tsa-a09-v29.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v29.question: What is being established now about earth?
premises: adhunā samastaṃ pṛthivītattvaṃ pramātṛprameyarūpam uddiśya nirūpyate — whole earth-tattva, knower-known-form, established.
yo dharātattvābhedena prakāśaḥ sa śivaḥ — what by earth-tattva-non-difference is light: that Śiva.
tsa-a09-v29.inference: The dharā-tattva analysis: its abheda-prakāśa is Śiva — earth read as non-different light.

tsa-a09-v30.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v30.question: What śruti supports this?
premises: yathā śrutiḥ pṛthivy evedaṃ brahma iti — as: in earth this very brahman.
tsa-a09-v30.inference: Vedic warrant: pṛthivī = idaṃ brahma in toto.

tsa-a09-v31.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v31.question: What is the earth-mantra chain?
premises: dharātattvasiddhipradān prerayati — impels giving earth-tattva-attainment.
sa dharāmantramaheśvaraḥ — earth-mantra-great-Lord.
preryo dharāmantreśaḥ — impelled earth-mantra-Lord.
tasyaivābhimānikavigrahatātmako vācaka mantraḥ — his expressive mantra made-of-imagined-image-nature.
sāṃkyādipāśavavidyottīrṇaśivavidyākrameṇa — by order Sāṃkhya-bonded-knowledge-crossed-Siva-knowledge.
abhyastapārthivayogo 'prāptadhruvapadaḥ — practiced-earth-yoga, not-reached-stable-stage.
dharāvijñānākalaḥ — earth-knowledge-portion.
tsa-a09-v31.inference: Five-link chain: maheśvara → mantreśa → mantra-vācaka (abhimānika-vigraha) → abhyasta-yoga → vijñānākala-stage.

tsa-a09-v32.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v32.question: What is the fallen earth-practice?
premises: pāśavavidyākrameṇa abhyastapārthivayogaḥ — practiced-earth-yoga by bonded-knowledge-order.
kalpānte maraṇe vā dharāpralayakevalaḥ — at cosmic-end or death: earth-dissolution-alone.
tsa-a09-v32.inference: Bonded-track yoga ends in dharā-pralaya-kevala — a one-tattva dissolution, not full liberation.

tsa-a09-v33.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v33.question: What happens in deep sleep for earth-graspers?
premises: sauṣupte hi tattvāveśavaśād eva citrasya svapnasya udayaḥ syāt — in deep sleep from tattva-immersion, varied dream would arise.
gṛhītadharābhimānas tu dharāsakalaḥ — earth-identity-grasped: earth-complete.
tsa-a09-v33.inference: Sleep for them is tattva-veśa-driven dream; their identity stays sakala-dharā.

tsa-a09-v34.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v34.question: How is earth fourteenfold here?
premises: atrāpi śaktyudrekanyagbhāvābhyāṃ caturdaśatvam — by power-raising-absence-nature: fourteenfold.
pramātṛtāpannasya dharātattvasya bhedāḥ — earth-tattva's differences of knower-nature-attained.
svarūpaṃ tu śuddham prameyam — own-nature pure knowable.
ity evam aparatrāpi — thus elsewhere-herein-even.
tsa-a09-v34.inference: 14 = 15 − 1 (power-absence): pramātṛtāpanna earth loses one; svarūpa remains pure prameya.

tsa-a09-v35.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v35.question: What is the sixteen-segment blue-analysis?
premises: ekasmin pramātari prāṇapratiṣṭhitatayā — in one knower by breath-establishment.
nīlaṃ gṛhṇataḥ prāṇaḥ tuṭiṣoḍaśakātmā vedyāveśaparyantam udeti — blue-grasping breath: sixteen-segment-self to knowable-immersion rises.
ādyā tuṭir avibhāgaikarūpā — first segment indivisible-one-form.
dvitīyā grāhakollāsarūpā — second knower-exultation-form.
antyā tu grāhyābhinnā tanmayī — last knowable-identical pervaded.
upāntyā tu sphuṭībhūtagrāhakarūpā — penultimate manifested-knower-form.

madhye tu yat tuṭidvādaśaka — middle twelve-segment: first six non-conceptual covering-concept sixness (one segment); covering-concept five-form (dawning, already-dawned: two-segment from pulsation's no-one-instant, own-work-agent); from fivefold and own-nature six non-conceptual instants; then non-conceptual dissolution → concept's dawning/already-dawned two-segment: six segments total.
iti ṣaṭ tuṭayaḥ — six segments.
tsa-a09-v35.inference: The tuṭi-math: 4 named + 12 middle (6 nirvikalpa + 6 vikalpa-pairs) = 16; six tuṭayaḥ as the operative cycle.

tsa-a09-v36.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v36.question: Who distinguishes the fifteenfold?
premises: svakāryakartṛtā tu grāhakarūpatā — own-work-agent-nature is knower-form-nature.
na sā bhūyo gaṇyate — she not counted further.
evam vivekadhanā gurūpaveśānuśīlinaḥ — wise-wealthed practising-teacher's-instruction.
sarvatra pāñcadaśyaṃ pravibhāgena viviñcate — distinguish fifteenfoldness everywhere by division.
tsa-a09-v36.inference: The grāhakarūpatā is excluded from the count (avagāṇya); the guru's pupils apply pravibhāga universally.

tsa-a09-v37.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v37.question: What follows from concept-lack?
premises: vikalpanyūnatve tu tuṭinyūnatā — in concept-lack: segment-lack.
sukhādisaṃvittāv iva — like bliss-and-rest-knowing.
yāvat avikalpataiva — as far as non-conceptualness-alone.
tsa-a09-v37.inference: Segments scale with concepts: fewer vikalpas → fewer tuṭis, floor at avikalpatā.

tsa-a09-v38.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v38.question: What do worlds think about the uncontemplated?
premises: lokās tu vikalpaviśrāntyā tām ahaṃtāmayīm — worlds by concept-rest: that ego-made.
ahaṃtācchāditedaṃbhāvavikalpaprasarāṃ nirvikalpāṃ vimarśabhuvam aprakāśitām iva manyante — the non-conceptual contemplation-abode covered by this-being-concept: unlit, they consider.
duḥkhāvasthāṃ sukhaviśrāntā iva — suffering-state like bliss-resting.
vikalpanirhrāsena tu sā prakāśata eva — by concept-decrease she shines indeed.
iti iyam asau sambandhe grāhyagrāhakayoḥ sāvadhānatā iti abhinavaguptaguravaḥ — attentiveness in knowable-knower relation: Abhinavagupta-teachers.
tsa-a09-v38.inference: The guru-perspective: ordinary worlds misread the avikalpā vimarśa-bhūmi as dark/suffering; vikalpa-decrease reveals it — sāvadhānatā is the method.

tsa-a09-v39.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v39.question: What is the two-segment Śiva-immersion?
premises: pāñcadaśye sthite yāvat sphuṭedaṃtātmano bhedasya nyūnatā — as far as distinct this-ness-difference's lack.
tāvat dvayaṃ dvayaṃ hrasati — so much pair-pair diminishes.
yāvat dvituṭikaḥ śivāveśaḥ — as far as two-segment Śiva-immersion.
ādyā tuṭiḥ sarvataḥ pūrṇā — first segment everywhere complete.
dvitīyā sarvajñānakaraṇāviṣṭābhyasyamānā sarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvāya kalpate — second pervaded, fit for omniscience-omnipotence.
na tu ādyā — not the first.
tsa-a09-v39.inference: Halving-progression: as idaṃtā-bheda wanes, tuṭi-pairs halve to 2; the SECOND (not first) tuṭi is the sarvajña-apt one.

tsa-a09-v40.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v40.question: What is the tuṭi-pāta secret?
premises: yad āha śrīkallaṭaḥ tuṭipāta iti — as Śrīkallaṭa says: segment-fall.
atra pātaśabdaṃ — here the fall-word.
saiva bhagavatī śrīmatkālī — she alone Śrīmatkālī.
mātṛsadbhāvo bhairavaḥ pratibhā — mother-being-nature, Bhairava, intuition.
alam rahasyārahasyanena — enough, by-secret-and-unsecret.
tsa-a09-v40.inference: Pāta (fall) = Kālī = mātṛ-sat-bhāva = bhairava-pratibhā: the word carries the Goddess; disclosure deliberately halts (alam).

tsa-a09-v41.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v41.question: What practice-attainment follows?
premises: mantramaheśatuṭeḥ prabhṛti — from mantra-great-Lord-segment onward.
tattadabhyāsāt tattatsiddhiḥ — from practice of that-and-that: attainment of that-and-that.
tsa-a09-v41.inference: Tuṭi-practice mapping: segment → corresponding siddhi by abhyāsa.

tsa-a09-v42.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v42.question: What establishes the states?
premises: athātraiva jāgradādyavasthā nirūpyante — waking-and-rest states established right here.
vedyasya tadviṣayāyāś ca saṃvido yat vaicitryam — variegation of knowable and its object and consciousness.
anyonyāpekṣaṃ sat sā avasthā — mutually-relative being: that is state.
na vedyasya kevalasya na cāpi kevalāyāḥ saṃvido na cāpi pṛthak pṛthak dve — not knowable-only, not consciousness-only, not two separate.
tsa-a09-v42.inference: Avasthā = relational vaicitrya (anyonyāpekṣa), irreducible to either term or their mere juxtaposition.

tsa-a09-v43.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v43.question: What is waking?
premises: yadādhiṣṭheyatayā bahīrūpatayā bhānaṃ — when shining by object-rulership, external-form-nature.
tadā jāgradavasthā — waking-state.
meye mātari māne ca — in-knowable, in-mother, in-measure.
tsa-a09-v43.inference: Waking = bahīrūpa-bhāna with adhiṣṭheya-rulership across meya/mātṛ/māna.

tsa-a09-v44.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v44.question: What is dream?
premises: yadā tu tatraiva adhiṣṭhānarūpatayā bhānaṃ saṃkalpaḥ — when right-therein by substratum-form-nature: will.
tadā svapnāvasthā — dream-state.
tsa-a09-v44.inference: Dream = same locus, adhiṣṭhāna-rūpa-bhāna, characterized as saṃkalpa.

tsa-a09-v45.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v45.question: What is deep sleep?
premises: yadā tu tatraiva adhiṣṭhātṛrūpatayā bhānaṃ bījātmatayaiva — when by ruler-form-nature, seed-self-nature alone.
tadā suṣuptāvasthā — deep-sleep-state.

tsa-a09-v46.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v46.question: How do the three states multiply?
premises: imā eva tisraḥ prameyapramāṇapramātravasthāḥ — these three known-instrument-knower-states.
pratyekaṃ jāgradādibhedāt caturvidhā uktāḥ — each by waking-and-rest-difference: fourfold said.
tsa-a09-v46.inference: 3 × 4 = 12: each of prameya/pramāṇa/pramātṛ-states has four avasthā-differences.

tsa-a09-v47.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v47.question: What is the fourth state?
premises: yadā tu tasminn eva pramātṛviśrāntigate — when in knower-rest-gone.
pramātuḥ pūrṇataunmukhyāt taddvāreṇa pūrṇatonmukhatayā bhānaṃ — from fullness-turning by its door.
tadā turyāvasthā — fourth-state.
sā ca rūpaṃ dṛśāham — form: I-see.
aṃśatrayam uttīrya paśyāmīti — triad-of-portions crossed: I-see-thus.
anupāyikā pramātṛtā svātantryasārā — unmediated knower-nature, autonomy-essence.
naikaṭyamadhyatvadūratvaiḥ pramātṛpramāṇaprameyatābhiṣekaṃ dadatī — not by sameness/middle/far: gives knower-instrument-known anointing.
tadavasthātrayānugrāhakatvāt tribhedā — serving three states: threefold.
tsa-a09-v47.inference: Turyā: pūrṇatā-door bhāna, 'I-see' form crossing aṃśatraya; anupāyikā pramātṛtā anoints the triad without spatial categories; tribhedā by service.

tsa-a09-v48.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v48.question: What vocabulary do yogins use for the four?
premises: etad eva avasthācatuṣṭayaṃ piṇḍasthapadastharūpastharūpātītaśabdair yogino vyavaharanti — yogins employ by piṇḍa-stha-padastha-rūpastha-rūpa-atīta.
prasaṃkhyānadhanās tu sarvatobhadraṃ vyāptiḥ mahāvyāptiḥ pracaya iti śabdaiḥ — contemplation-wealthy: sarvato-bhadra, vyāpti, mahāvyāpti, pracaya.
tsa-a09-v48.inference: Two vocabularies for the same four: yogin-standard (piṇḍa-stha…) vs prasaṃkhyāna-dhana (sarvato-bhadra…).

tsa-a09-v49.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v49.question: Where is this shown?
premises: anvarthaṃ cātra darśitaṃ tantrāloke ślokavārttike ca — corresponding-sense shown in Tantrāloka and Ślokavārttika.
tsa-a09-v49.inference: Dual citation: Tantrāloka + Ślokavārttika for the anvartha-display.

tsa-a09-v50.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v50.question: What establishes beyond-fourth?
premises: yac ca sarvāntarbhūtaṃ pūrṇarūpaṃ — what contained-in-all complete-form.
tat turyātītaṃ sarvātītaṃ mahāpracayaṃ ca nirūpayanti — that beyond-fourth, beyond-all, great-accumulation: they establish.

tsa-a09-v51.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v51.question: How do the states map onto the levels?
premises: yasya yad yadā rūpaṃ sphuṭaṃ sthiram anubandhi tat jāgrat — distinct-stable-continuous: waking.
tasyaiva tadviparyayaḥ svapnaḥ — its opposite: dream.
yaḥ layākalasya bhogaḥ sarvāvedanaṃ suṣuptam — laya-ākala's enjoyment all-knowing: deep sleep.
yo vijñānākalasya bhogaḥ bhogyābhinnīkaraṇaṃ turyam — vijñānākala's: identifying-with-enjoyable: fourth.
mantrādīnāṃ sa bhogaḥ bhāvānāṃ śivābhedas — mantra-and-rest's: enjoyment of states: Siva-non-difference.
turyātītaṃ sarvātītam — beyond-fourth, beyond-all.
tsa-a09-v51.inference: State-to-level mapping: jāgrat→svapna→suṣupta→turyā (by ākala-bhoga types), then śivābhedas → turyātīta/sarvātīta for mantra-and-rest.

tsa-a09-v52.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v52.question: What are the five states in fifteenfold?
premises: svarūpasakalau 1 pralayākalaḥ 2 vijñānākalaḥ 3 mantratadīśatanmaheśavargaḥ 4 śivaḥ 5 — numbered list.
iti pañcadaśabhede pañca avasthāḥ — thus in fifteenfold five states.
tsa-a09-v52.inference: Five avasthās keyed to the level-classes within pañcadaśa: svarūpa+sakala (1), pralayākala (2), vijñānākala (3), mantra-group (4), Śiva (5).

tsa-a09-v53.speaker: Teacher (saptadhā-tattva-pramātṛ doctrine)
tsa-a09-v53.question: What is the full descent-table?
premises: svarūpaṃ pralayākala ityādikrameṇa trayodaśabhede svarūpaṃ vijñānākalaśaktiḥ — thirteenfold: svarūpa, vijñānākala-śakti.
vijñānākala ity ekādaśabhede svarūpaṃ mantrāḥ tadīśāḥ maheśāḥ śivaḥ — elevenfold: mantras, those-Lords, great-Lords, Śiva.
ity navabhede svarūpaṃ mantreśāḥ maheśaḥ śaktiḥ śiva — ninefold: mantreśas, maheśa, śakti, Śiva.
ity saptabhede svarūpaṃ maheśaśaktiḥ maheśaḥ śaktiḥ śiva — sevenfold.
ity pañcabhede svarūpaṃ kriyāśaktiḥ jñānaśaktiḥ icchāśaktiḥ śiva — fivefold: three powers + Śiva.

ity tribhede abhinne 'pi śivatattve kriyājñānecchānandacidrūpakḷptyā prasaṃkhyānayogadhanāḥ pañcapadatvam āhuḥ — threefold, in non-different Siva-tattva, by structuring as action-knowledge-will-bliss-consciousness: contemplation-wealthy say five-stage-nature.
tsa-a09-v53.inference: The full table: 13→11→9→7→5→3 with svarūpa descending through each level's composition; at 3 (tribheda) the tri-power structuring underwrites pañca-pada — count-systems converge.

tsa-a09-v01.plain_english: That, sevenfold, the six-and-half-fold scripture is taught by the Supreme Lord alone.
tsa-a09-v01.sanskrit_cite: sa ca saptadhā ṣaḍardhaśāstra eva paraṃ parameśena uktaḥ

tsa-a09-v02.plain_english: There: Śivas, mantra-great-Lords, mantra-Lords, mantras, knowledge-portions, dissolution-portions, complete — seven power-bearing.
tsa-a09-v02.sanskrit_cite: tatra śivāḥ mantramaheśāḥ mantreśāḥ mantrāḥ vijñānākalāḥ pralayākalāḥ sakalā iti sapta śaktimantaḥ

tsa-a09-v03.plain_english: Of these seven powers, by their difference up to the earth-and-rest principal tattva: each its own form by fourteen differences — fifteenfold.
tsa-a09-v03.sanskrit_cite: eṣāṃ saptaiva śaktayaḥ tadbhedāt pṛthivyādipradhānatattvāntaṃ caturdaśabhir bhedaiḥ pratyekaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ pañcadaśam

tsa-a09-v04.plain_english: There: own form fit for knowability, self-established, by the grace of Aparābhaṭṭārikā — in the power-raised knower-objects the rest-receptacle: that is the śākta form itself, by the grace of Śrīmatparāparā; and that too is sevenfold, from the powers being as many.
tsa-a09-v04.sanskrit_cite: tatra svaṃ rūpaṃ prameyatāyogyaṃ svātmaniṣṭham aparābhaṭṭārikānugrahāt pramātṛṣu udriktaśaktiṣu yat viśrāntibhājanaṃ tat tasyaiva śāktaṃ rūpaṃ śrīmatparāparānugrahāt tac ca saptavidhaṃ śaktīnāṃ tāvattvāt

tsa-a09-v05.plain_english: In the power-bearing-form-principal, however, what rests in the knower-class: that power-bearing Siva-form, by the grace of Śrīmatparābhaṭṭārikā — sevenfold too.
tsa-a09-v05.sanskrit_cite: śaktimadrūpapradhāne tu pramātṛvarge yat viśrāntaṃ tac chaktimac chivarūpaṃ śrīmatparābhaṭṭārikānugrahāt tad api saptavidham

tsa-a09-v06.plain_english: From Śiva to the complete-limit — from those many being said.
tsa-a09-v06.sanskrit_cite: pramātṝṇāṃ śivāt prabhṛti sakalāntānāṃ tāvatām uktatvāt

tsa-a09-v07.plain_english: There the difference of knower-objects is from power-difference alone; and for clarification it is said by the order of complete and the rest: in complete, knowledge-portion, power — from being its specific form (the mind-, action- and instrument-powers); of the dissolution-portion, those same from objectlessness, indistinct.
tsa-a09-v07.sanskrit_cite: tatra śaktibhedād eva pramātṝṇāṃ bhedaḥ sa ca sphuṭīkaraṇārthaṃ sakalādikrameṇa bhaṇyate tatra sakalasya vidyākale śaktiḥ tadviśeṣarūpatvāt buddhikarmākṣaśaktīnāṃ pralayākalasya tu te eva nirviṣayatvāt asphuṭe

tsa-a09-v08.plain_english: Of the knowledge-portion, those same, in the dissolving-portion, helper of its impression, awakening — the pure knowledge of mantra.
tsa-a09-v08.sanskrit_cite: vijñānākalasya te eva vigalatkalpe tatsaṃskārasacivā prabudhyamānā śuddhavidyā mantrasya

tsa-a09-v09.plain_english: Devoid of that impression: she alone awakened, of the mantra-Lord.

tsa-a09-v10.plain_english: She alone, desiring the will-power-form, autonomy-natured, of the mantra-great-Lord.

tsa-a09-v11.plain_english: Will-natured, distinct-autonomy-natured, of Śiva — thus the power-differences: seven primary.
tsa-a09-v11.sanskrit_cite: icchātmikā sphuṭasvātantryātmikā śivasya iti śaktibhedāḥ sapta mukhyāḥ

tsa-a09-v12.plain_english: And the difference in the power-bearing knower-objects is made by its tainting: instrument-difference ends in agent-difference; and from power alone — non-separate — being able to act; not of another, from the fallacy of infinite regress and the rest.
tsa-a09-v12.sanskrit_cite: taduparāgakṛtaś ca śaktimatsu pramātṛṣu bhedaḥ karaṇabhedasya kartṛbhedaparyavasānāt śakter eva ca avyatiriktāyāḥ karaṇīkartuṃ śakyatvāt na anyasya anavasthādyāpatteḥ

tsa-a09-v13.plain_english: In reality, however, one alone — consciousness-autonomy-bliss-resting knower; there earth, resting in own-nature-merely, when known, its own nature alone shines: seen by the mind's eye, known by the mind, I know — there the other own-nature made by complete-power, made by power-bearing-form, shines too; thus up to Śiva also is to be said: world established in Śiva-power, resting in Śiva-nature, I know — from the conviction being of a different kind.
tsa-a09-v13.sanskrit_cite: vastutaḥ punar eka eva citsvātantryānandaviśrāntaḥ pramātā tatra pṛthivī svarūpamātraviśrāntā yadā vedyate tadā svarūpam asyāḥ kevalaṃ bhāti caitracakṣurdṛṣṭaṃ caitraviditaṃ jānāmīti tatra sakalaśaktikṛtaṃ sakalaśaktimadrūpakṛtaṃ svarūpāntaraṃ bhāty eva evaṃ śivāntam api vācyaṃ śivaśaktiniṣṭhaṃ śivasvabhāvaviśrāntaṃ ca viśvaṃ jānāmi iti pratyayasya vilakṣaṇasya bhāvāt

tsa-a09-v14.plain_english: But if the state's knowability is its own body, then knowability toward all, knowability of the knowable too — infinite regress; by that, the world's blindness well-luminous; by that, the union of opposite qualities in knowable-unknowable: fault — so it is said here.
tsa-a09-v14.sanskrit_cite: nanu bhāvasya cet vedyatā svaṃ vapuḥ tat sarvān prati vedyatvaṃ vedyatvam api vedyam ity anavasthā tayā ca jagato 'ndhasuptatvaṃ suprakāśam eva tayā ca vedyatvāvedyatve viruddhadharmayoga iti doṣaḥ atra ucyate

tsa-a09-v15.plain_english: Not that own body: from own-nature being separately said; but what? In knower-power and in the knower the rest-receptacle, the form — that self-luminous itself shines, not toward anything at all: thus omniscience; regress and opposite-quality-union — far removed.
tsa-a09-v15.sanskrit_cite: na tat svaṃ vapuḥ svarūpasya pṛthaguktatvāt kiṃ tarhi tat pramātṛśaktau pramātari ca yat viśrāntibhājanaṃ yat rūpaṃ tat khalu tat tat svaprakāśam eva tat prakāśate na tu kiṃcid api prati iti sarvajñatvam anavasthāviruddhadharmayogaś ca iti dūrāpāstam

tsa-a09-v16.plain_english: Known by infinite knower-objects too: one alone, its form in those, from the one-shining-form nature: no obstruction by another knower's knowing-inference; and that its form is real, from doing work for meaning; like seeing a beloved seen by another becoming jealous: seeing Śiva-nature, the rest-pot, one enters completely; seeing reality resting in all infinite knower-objects one becomes full, like watching a dancer; her blue's form resting in the knower — from the arising of self-luminous contemplation: thus the fifteenfold nature of earth up to the principal tattva.
tsa-a09-v16.sanskrit_cite: anantapramātṛsaṃvedyam api ekam eva tat tasya rūpaṃ tāvati teṣām ekābhāsarūpatvāt iti na pramātrantarasaṃvedanānumānavighnaḥ kaścit tac ca tasya rūpaṃ satyam arthakriyākāritvāt tathaiva paradṛśyamānāṃ kāntāṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyai samīrṣyati śivasvabhāvaṃ viśrāntikumbhaṃ paśyan samāviśati samastānantapramātṛviśrāntaṃ vastu paśyan pūrṇībhavati nartakīprekṣaṇavat tasyaiva nīlasya tadrūpaṃ pramātari yat viśrāntaṃ tathaiva svaprakāśasya vimarśasyodayāt iti pañcadaśātmakatvaṃ pṛthivyāḥ prabhṛti pradhānatattvaparyantam

tsa-a09-v17.plain_english: In that much — the complete's knower-nature from the raised passion-and-rest curtain — the complete's fifteenfoldness too thus, from its that-much knowability.
tsa-a09-v17.sanskrit_cite: tāvaty udriktarāgādikañcukasya sakalasya pramātṛtvāt sakalasyāpi evaṃ pāñcadaśyaṃ tasyāpi tāvad vedyatvāt

tsa-a09-v18.plain_english: Spread, this is settled in the Tantrāloka.

tsa-a09-v19.plain_english: From the male up to the segment-tattva: thirteenfold.

tsa-a09-v20.plain_english: Complete's there, by union with knower-nature, from suppression of its two differences power/power-bearing-self: thus complete's own-nature merely; the dissolution-portion's in own-nature, five's in knower-nature: eleven differences.
tsa-a09-v20.sanskrit_cite: sakalasya tatra pramātṛtāyogena tacchaktiśaktimadātmano bhedadvayasya pratyastamayāt tathā ca sakalasya svarūpatvam eva kevalaṃ pralayākalasya svarūpatve pañcānāṃ pramātṛtve ekādaśa bhedāḥ

tsa-a09-v21.plain_english: The knowledge-portion's in own-nature, four's in knower-nature: nine differences.
tsa-a09-v21.sanskrit_cite: vijñānākalasya svarūpatve caturṇāṃ pramātṛtve nava bhedāḥ

tsa-a09-v22.plain_english: Mantra's in own-nature, three's in knower-nature: seven.

tsa-a09-v23.plain_english: The mantra-Lord's in own-nature, two's in knower-nature: five.

tsa-a09-v24.plain_english: The mantra-great-Lord's in own-nature, the Lord's one alone in knower-nature, from power-power-bearing-difference: three.
tsa-a09-v24.sanskrit_cite: mantramaheśasya svarūpatve bhagavata ekasyaiva pramātṛtve śaktiśaktimadbhedāt trayaḥ

tsa-a09-v25.plain_english: Śiva's, however — dependent on light-one-consciousness-autonomy: no difference at all, from fullness.
tsa-a09-v25.sanskrit_cite: śivasya tu prakāśaikacitsvātantryanirbharasya na ko 'pi bhedaḥ paripūrṇatvāt

tsa-a09-v26.plain_english: Thus tattva-difference itself is established in the Supreme-Lord's unsurpassable-policy-one-name, and makes the variegation of world-difference: of hell, heaven and rudra-worlds, earthness being equal too, from the farther nature-difference being said.
tsa-a09-v26.sanskrit_cite: evam ayaṃ tattvabheda eva parameśvarānuttaranayaikākhye nirūpitaḥ bhuvanabhedavaicitryaṃ karoti narakasvargarudrabhuvanānāṃ pārthivatve samāne 'pi dūratarasya svabhāvabhedasya uktatvāt

tsa-a09-v27.plain_english: And here, by mutual construction of difference, curious for inner-difference-knowledge: let him determine the Tantrāloka alone.
tsa-a09-v27.sanskrit_cite: atra ca parasparaṃ bhedakalanayā avāntarabhedajñānakutūhalī tantrālokam eva avadhārayet

tsa-a09-v28.plain_english: Thus by following each pot and the rest too, the difference of earth-and-rest tattvas is established.
tsa-a09-v28.sanskrit_cite: evam ekaikaghaṭādyanusāreṇāpi pṛthivyādīnāṃ tattvānāṃ bhedo nirūpitaḥ

tsa-a09-v29.plain_english: Now the whole earth-tattva, targeted as knower-known-form, is established: what by earth-tattva-non-difference is light — that is Śiva.
tsa-a09-v29.sanskrit_cite: adhunā samastaṃ pṛthivītattvaṃ pramātṛprameyarūpam uddiśya nirūpyate yo dharātattvābhedena prakāśaḥ sa śivaḥ

tsa-a09-v30.plain_english: As the Vedic text: in earth this very brahman.
tsa-a09-v30.sanskrit_cite: yathā śrutiḥ pṛthivy evedaṃ brahma iti

tsa-a09-v31.plain_english: It impels the giving of earth-tattva-attainment: the earth-mantra-great-Lord; impelled, the earth-mantra-Lord; his expressive mantra made of imagined-image-nature, by the order of Sāṃkhya-and-rest bonded-knowledge-crossed-Śiva-knowledge, the practiced earth-yoga not reaching the stable stage: the earth-knowledge-portion.
tsa-a09-v31.sanskrit_cite: dharātattvasiddhipradān prerayati sa dharāmantramaheśvaraḥ preryo dharāmantreśaḥ tasyaivābhimānikavigrahatātmako vācako mantraḥ sāṃkhyādipāśavavidyottīrṇaśivavidyākrameṇa abhyastapārthivayogo 'prāptadhruvapadaḥ dharāvijñānākalaḥ

tsa-a09-v32.plain_english: By bonded-knowledge-order the practiced earth-yoga: at cosmic-end or in death, earth-dissolution-alone.
tsa-a09-v32.sanskrit_cite: pāśavavidyākrameṇa abhyastapārthivayogaḥ kalpānte maraṇe vā dharāpralayakevalaḥ

tsa-a09-v33.plain_english: In deep sleep, from tattva-immersion alone, varied dream would arise; the earth-identity-grasped, however: earth-complete.
tsa-a09-v33.sanskrit_cite: sauṣupte hi tattvāveśavaśād eva citrasya svapnasya udayaḥ syāt gṛhītadharābhimānas tu dharāsakalaḥ

tsa-a09-v34.plain_english: Even here by power-raising-absence-nature: fourteenfold — thus the differences of the earth-tattva having attained knower-nature; own-nature, however, pure knowable — thus elsewhere-here-in-even.
tsa-a09-v34.sanskrit_cite: atrāpi śaktyudrekanyagbhāvābhyāṃ caturdaśatvam iti pramātṛtāpannasya dharātattvasya bhedāḥ svarūpaṃ tu śuddhaṃ prameyam iti evam aparatrāpi

tsa-a09-v35.plain_english: Now in one knower, by being established in breath, the difference-determination: here the blue-grasping one, breath, sixteen-segment-self, rises up to knowable-immersion. There the first segment indivisible-one-form; the second knower-exultation-form; the last knowable-identical pervaded; the penultimate manifested-knower-form; in the middle, the twelve-segment — from among them the first six-group non-conceptual-natured, covering-concept sixness: as its own nature one segment; in the covering-concept five-form-nature, dawning-willingness, already-dawned — she two-segment-bodied from pulsation's absence-of-one-instant-form, own-work-agent-nature — thus from the covering-concept's fivefoldness, and from own-nature six non-conceptual instants; then from non-conceptual's dissolution-likeness: dissolution of concept, dawning-willingness, two-segment-bodied already-dawned: six segments.
tsa-a09-v35.sanskrit_cite: atha ekasmin pramātari prāṇapratiṣṭhitatayā bhedanirūpaṇam iha nīlaṃ gṛhṇataḥ prāṇaḥ tuṭiṣoḍaśakātmā vedyāveśaparyantam udeti tatra ādyā tuṭir avibhāgaikarūpā dvitīyā grāhakollāsarūpā antyā tu grāhyābhinnā tanmayī upāntyā tu sphuṭībhūtagrāhakarūpā madhye tu yat tuṭidvādaśaka tanmadhyāt ādyaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ nirvikalpasvabhāvaṃ vikalpāc chādakaṃ ṣaṭtvaṃ ca asya svarūpeṇa ekā tuṭiḥ ācchādanīye ca vikalpe pañcarūpatvam unmimiṣā unmiṣattā sā ca iyaṃ sphuṭakriyārūpatvāt tuṭidvayātmikā spandanasya ekakṣaṇarūpatvābhāvāt unmiṣitatā svakāryakartṛtvaṃ ca ity evam ācchādanīyavikalpapāñcavidhyāt svarūpāc ca ṣaṭ kṣaṇā nirvikalpakāḥ tato 'pi nirvikalpasya dhvaṃsamānatā dhvaṃso vikalpasya unmimiṣā unmiṣattā tuṭidvayātmikā unmiṣitatā ca iti ṣaṭ tuṭayaḥ

tsa-a09-v36.plain_english: Own-work-agent-nature is knower-form-nature — said; she is not counted further — thus the wise-wealthed, practising the teacher's instruction, distinguish fifteenfoldness everywhere by division.
tsa-a09-v36.sanskrit_cite: svakāryakartṛtā tu grāhakarūpatā iti uktaṃ na sā bhūyo gaṇyate ity evaṃ vivekadhanā gurūpaveśānuśīlinaḥ sarvatra pāñcadaśyaṃ pravibhāgena viviñcate

tsa-a09-v37.plain_english: In concept-lack: segment-lack, in bliss-and-rest-knowing — like, as far as non-conceptualness alone.
tsa-a09-v37.sanskrit_cite: vikalpanyūnatve tu tuṭinyūnatā sukhādisaṃvittāv iva yāvat avikalpataiva

tsa-a09-v38.plain_english: The worlds too, by concept-rest, consider that ego-made, the spread-of-this-being-concept-covered, non-conceptual contemplation-abode unlit — like a suffering-state resting in bliss; but by concept-decrease she shines indeed — thus this attentiveness in the relation of knowable and knower: the Abhinavagupta-teachers.
tsa-a09-v38.sanskrit_cite: lokās tu vikalpaviśrāntyā tām ahaṃtāmayīm ahaṃtācchāditedaṃbhāvavikalpaprasarāṃ nirvikalpāṃ vimarśabhuvam aprakāśitām iva manyante duḥkhāvasthāṃ sukhaviśrāntā iva vikalpanirhrāsena tu sā prakāśata eva iti iyam asau sambandhe grāhyagrāhakayoḥ sāvadhānatā iti abhinavaguptaguravaḥ

tsa-a09-v39.plain_english: Thus in fifteenfold standing, as far as the lack of the distinct this-ness-self's difference, so much pair-pair diminishes; as far as two-segment Śiva-immersion: there the first segment everywhere complete; the second pervaded-by-all-knowledge-instruments being-practised, fit for omniscience-omnipotence — not the first.
tsa-a09-v39.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ ca pāñcadaśye sthite yāvat sphuṭedaṃtātmano bhedasya nyūnatā tāvat dvayaṃ dvayaṃ hrasati yāvat dvituṭikaḥ śivāveśaḥ tatra ādyā tuṭiḥ sarvataḥ pūrṇā dvitīyā sarvajñānakaraṇāviṣṭābhyasyamānā sarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvāya kalpate na tu ādyā

tsa-a09-v40.plain_english: As Śrīkallaṭa says: segment-fall — here the fall-word: she alone the Goddess Śrīmatkālī, mother-being-nature, Bhairava, intuition — enough, by secret-and-unsecret.
tsa-a09-v40.sanskrit_cite: yad āha śrīkallaṭaḥ tuṭipāta iti atra pātaśabdaṃ saiva bhagavatī śrīmatkālī mātṛsadbhāvo bhairavaḥ pratibhā ity alaṃ rahasyārahasyanena

tsa-a09-v41.plain_english: Thus from the mantra-great-Lord-segment onward, from the practice of that-and-that, attainment of that-and-that.

tsa-a09-v42.plain_english: Now here the waking-and-rest states are established: the variegation of the knowable and its object and consciousness — mutually-relative being — that is a state: not of the knowable-merely, nor of consciousness-merely, nor two separate.
tsa-a09-v42.sanskrit_cite: athātraiva jāgradādyavasthā nirūpyante tatra vedyasya tadviṣayāyāś ca saṃvido yat vaicitryam anyonyāpekṣaṃ sat sā avasthā na vedyasya kevalasya na cāpi kevalāyāḥ saṃvido na cāpi pṛthak pṛthak dve

tsa-a09-v43.plain_english: There when, by object-rulership, by external-form-nature, shining: waking-state, in-knowable, in-mother, in-measure.
tsa-a09-v43.sanskrit_cite: tatra yadādhiṣṭheyatayā bahīrūpatayā bhānaṃ tadā jāgradavasthā meye mātari māne ca

tsa-a09-v44.plain_english: When, however, right there by substratum-form-nature shining — will: dream-state.
tsa-a09-v44.sanskrit_cite: yadā tu tatraiva adhiṣṭhānarūpatayā bhānaṃ saṃkalpaḥ tadā svapnāvasthā

tsa-a09-v45.plain_english: When, however, right there by ruler-form-nature shining, by seed-self-nature alone: deep-sleep-state.
tsa-a09-v45.sanskrit_cite: yadā tu tatraiva adhiṣṭhātṛrūpatayā bījātmatayaiva bhānaṃ tadā suṣuptāvasthā

tsa-a09-v46.plain_english: These three known-instrument-knower-states, each by the waking-and-rest difference: fourfold said.
tsa-a09-v46.sanskrit_cite: imā eva tisraḥ prameyapramāṇapramātravasthāḥ pratyekaṃ jāgradādibhedāt caturvidhā uktāḥ

tsa-a09-v47.plain_english: When, however, in the very knower-rest-gone, from the knower's fullness-turning, by its door fullness-turning shining: fourth-state; she form I-see — of this kind the triad-of-portions crossed, I-see-thus: unmediated knower-nature, autonomy-essence, not by sameness-middleness-farness gives the anointing of knower-instrument-known-ness; from serving the three states: threefold.
tsa-a09-v47.sanskrit_cite: yadā tu tasminn eva pramātṛviśrāntigate pramātuḥ pūrṇataunmukhyāt taddvāreṇa pūrṇatonmukhatayā bhānaṃ tadā turyāvasthā sā ca rūpaṃ dṛśāham ity evaṃvidham aṃśatrayam uttīrya paśyāmīti anupāyikā pramātṛtā svātantryasārā naikaṭyamadhyatvadūratvaiḥ pramātṛpramāṇaprameyatābhiṣekaṃ dadatī tadavasthātrayānugrāhakatvāt tribhedā

tsa-a09-v48.plain_english: This four-state-set yogins employ by the words piṇḍa-stha, padastha, rūpastha, rūpa-atīta; the contemplation-wealthy, however: by the words all-auspicious, pervasion, great-pervasion, accumulation.
tsa-a09-v48.sanskrit_cite: etad eva avasthācatuṣṭayaṃ piṇḍasthapadastharūpastharūpātītaśabdair yogino vyavaharanti prasaṃkhyānadhanās tu sarvatobhadraṃ vyāptiḥ mahāvyāptiḥ pracaya iti śabdaiḥ

tsa-a09-v49.plain_english: And the corresponding-sense is shown here in the Tantrāloka and the Ślokavārttika.
tsa-a09-v49.sanskrit_cite: anvarthaṃ cātra darśitaṃ tantrāloke ślokavārttike ca

tsa-a09-v50.plain_english: And what is contained in all, complete-form — that beyond-fourth, beyond-all, great-accumulation: they establish.
tsa-a09-v50.sanskrit_cite: yac ca sarvāntarbhūtaṃ pūrṇarūpaṃ tat turyātītaṃ sarvātītaṃ mahāpracayaṃ ca nirūpayanti

tsa-a09-v51.plain_english: Moreover whose what, when form distinct, stable, continuous — that is waking; its opposite, dream; which is the dissolution-portion's enjoyment, all-knowing: deep sleep; which the knowledge-portion's enjoyment, identifying-with-enjoyable: fourth; mantra-and-rest's: that enjoyment of states, Śiva-non-difference; beyond-fourth, beyond-all.
tsa-a09-v51.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ ca yasya yad yadā rūpaṃ sphuṭaṃ sthiram anubandhi tat jāgrat tasyaiva tadviparyayaḥ svapnaḥ yaḥ layākalasya bhogaḥ sarvāvedanaṃ suṣuptaṃ yo vijñānākalasya bhogaḥ bhogyābhinnīkaraṇaṃ turyaṃ mantrādīnāṃ sa bhogaḥ bhāvānāṃ śivābhedas turyātītaṃ sarvātītam

sections.FUNCTION: Establishes the seven-fold power-ladder and its arithmetic (pañcadaśa/trayodaśa/11-9-7-5-3-0 counts), the ekābhāsa doctrine of one-form-many-knowers, the objection-answer on vedyatā, the earth-mantra chain, the sixteen-segment tuṭi-analysis, and the four-avasthā system with turyā — closing with the descent-table.
sections.KEY TERMS: sapta-śaktimantaḥ (the seven power-bearing); pañcadaśa/trayodaśa-bheda (fifteen/thirteenfold counts); viśrānti-bhājana (rest-receptacle = vedyatā's locus); ekābhāsa (one-shining-form); tuṭi-ṣoḍaśaka (sixteen segments); sāvadhānatā (knowable-knower attentiveness, guru-view); turyā (fourth, 'I-see' aṃśatraya); avasthā-traya ×4 (twelve) + pañca-avasthā in pañcadaśa; śiva-abheda (zero-bheda at paripūrṇatā).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 9 carries the saptadhā-śāstra schema from a08; cross-links Tantrāloka (u18, u27, u49) + Ślokavārttika (u49) + Śrīkallaṭa (u40) + Abhinavagupta-guravaḥ (u38); the earth-series (u29-34) opens the pṛthivī-ādi treatment continued in later āhnikas.
sections.BOUNDARY: Thirteenfold vs fifteenfold counts juxtaposed without full reconciliation (u19 vs u3); tuṭi-math asserted (u35) with steps compacted; Kālī-pāta secret explicitly halted (alam, u40); two vocabularies for four states (u48) offered without equivalence proof; u53's table dense — each cell unexpanded.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) the seven-power ladder with three-grace rūpa-pairings (Aparā/parāparā/parābhaṭṭārikā) and count-arithmetic down to zero-bheda Śiva; (2) ekābhāsa epistemology answering the vedyatā-regress objection; (3) pṛthivī-tattva as Śiva-prakāśa with mantra-chain and bonded-track falls; (4) tuṭi-segment analysis of blue-perception with sāvadhānatā hermeneutic; (5) avasthā as relational vaicitrya → turyā anointing → dual vocabularies → level-mapping → the descent-table closing at tribheda-pañca-pada.
sections.RELATED: GRETIL Tantrasāra ahnika 9 (KSTS 17); Tantrāloka + Ślokavārttika cited; a08/a10 count-dialogue kin; earth-series continues in later āhnikas; qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.
